svg.text: Vitamin C keeps the collagen hydroxylases working
Scurvy: no ascorbate → iron stuck as Fe³⁺ → too little Hyp and Hyl
Fewer Hyp residues: the triple helix is unstable at body temperature.
Fewer Hyl residues: fewer sites for later cross-links (made by lysyl oxidase, a Cu enzyme).
✓ vitamin C is a cofactor for an enzyme, not part of the chain
